sanskrit_verse:
गृहधान्याभयोपानच्छत्रमाल्यानुलेपनम् ।
यानं वृक्षं प्रियं शय्यां दत्त्वा अत्यन्तं सुखी भवेत् ॥
transliteration: gṛhadhānyābhayopānacchatramālyānulepanam | yānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ priyaṃ śayyāṃ dattvā atyantaṃ sukhī bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who bestows shelter, grain, assurance of safety, footwear, umbrella, garlands, ointments, conveyance, shade-giving tree, beloved companion, and resting place attains absolute bliss.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through capacity to give and sustain life conditions
Causation flows from generosity as a source of harmony
Capacity-based responsibility includes enabling others' well-being
Restoration logic centers on reciprocal flourishing
Consciousness alignment occurs when giving aligns with dharmic necessity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent provides any of: shelter, food, security, transport, comfort items THEN increase societal integration index by 0.75
IF individual receives essential support THEN system must ensure no further deprivation for 360 days
IF resource transfer enables self-sufficiency THEN mark completion in social restoration ledger
IF act of giving aligns with recipient's dharma THEN classify action as sovereign alignment event
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, this verse establishes that provision of existential necessities constitutes fulfillment of highest dharma. Legal thresholds of responsibility must account for capacity to give rather than mere possession. Courts must evaluate not just legality but alignment with foundational life-support structures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa shows that joy follows from giving, not taking. Anupūrvaśaḥ demonstrates sequential emergence of bliss upon completion of full gift cycle. Responsibility lies with those capable of sustaining life conditions. There is no punitive frame; only causal recognition that withholding leads to dissonance while giving creates alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Gift Circulation Protocol: Identify surplus assets and direct toward systemic scarcity zones
Activate Reciprocal Integration Process: Ensure givers and receivers enter mutual recognition cycles
Deploy Consciousness Re-alignment Module: Redirect accumulation patterns toward distribution excellence
Complete Social Harmony Loop: Validate all transfers result in measurable elevation of collective well-being
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Dharma. Bliss emerges through conscious giving. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Dharma is restored.
